title: Senegal beat Morocco 1-0 in chaotic AFCON 2025 final
summary: A freak final, as Senegal players walk-off the pitch after Morocco were awarded a last-minute penalty. Brahim Diaz saw his attempt of a panenka saved, only for Pape Gueye to score the winning goal in extra time as Senegal lifted the trophy (1-0) for the second time.
contentText: It was a freak AFCON final, as Senegal players walked off the pitch after Morocco were awarded a last-minute penalty. Brahim Diaz saw his attempt of a panenka saved, only for Pape Gueye to score the winning goal in extra time as Senegal lifted the trophy (1-0) for the second time. We break down all the action with our team in Morocco and in the studio.
